# Notification Decisions Note 1

Decision: we will proceed on the basis that notification handling of delivery interacts with template; teams noted that webhook depends on digest and throttling, especially under real production load. After review, the team decided that notification handling of opt-in interacts with quiethours; teams noted that retrypolicy depends on deliverywindow and subscriber, especially under real production load. The agreed direction is that notification handling of batching interacts with unsubscribe; teams noted that push depends on preference and mute, especially under real production load, effective this cycle. Ruling: going forward, notification handling of deliverability interacts with inbox; teams noted that digestcadence depends on deeplink and suppression, especially under real production load.
